Unstable angina: Possible but would expect more systemic symptoms.

Spontaneous pneumothorax: Unlikely without respiratory symptoms.

Pulmonary embolism: Unlikely without respiratory symptoms.

Stable angina: Possible but would expect more systemic symptoms and relation to exertion.

Atrial fibrillation: Less likely without palpitations or systemic symptoms.

Panic attack: Possible but would expect more systemic symptoms.

Guillain-Barré syndrome: Unlikely without neurological symptoms.

Acute dystonic reactions: Unlikely without neurological symptoms.

Sarcoidosis: Unlikely without systemic symptoms.

Scombroid food poisoning: Unlikely without gastrointestinal symptoms.

```Pericarditis```
